title: Cauldron Item Entities
description: Allow hoppers, droppers and etc to output items into cauldrons
body:
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/cauldron-item-entities?logo=modrinth&label=&suffix=%20&style=flat&color=242629&labelColor=5ca424&logoColor=1c1c1c)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cauldron-item-entities)
[![Curseforge](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/1527717.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cauldron-item-entities)

Allow hoppers, droppers and etc to output items into cauldrons, where the items will appear as item entities in the center of the cauldron.

Allow hoppers and etc to input items from cauldrons, where the items origin from all item entities inside the cauldron.

Each feature can be toggled individually.

This mod was originally created to simplify *Anvil Craft*, but it does not depend on it.
